description: Ancient Jerusalem at sunrise from the Mount of Olives
alt: Ancient Jerusalem glowing gold at sunrise, seen from an olive grove with a traveller on the path.
interpretation_note: Artistic reconstruction of Second Temple-era Jerusalem; architecture is approximate, not an archaeological model.

description: Light breaking over the primordial waters
alt: Rays of light breaking over dark waters as land and plants emerge.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

description: The ark after the flood with a rainbow
alt: A large wooden ark on a hillside under a rainbow as animals walk out in pairs.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The ark's shape is imagined; Genesis 6:15 gives only its dimensions.

alt: An old man outside a desert tent gazing up at a sky full of stars.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

description: Joseph in his coat with his brothers
alt: A young man in a colourful coat stands in a field while older brothers watch from a distance.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

description: The parting of the Red Sea
alt: A leader raises his staff as the sea parts into towering walls and people cross on dry ground.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The people's appearance is imagined and deliberately varied. Exodus 12:38 says a 'mixed multitude' went up with Israel.

alt: A young shepherd with a sling faces an armoured giant in a valley between two armies.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The people's appearance is imagined and deliberately varied.

alt: A calm man in robes stands among resting lions in a dim stone den.

alt: A queen approaches a Persian king on his throne as he extends a golden sceptre.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The people's appearance is imagined and deliberately varied. Esther 1:1 describes a kingdom stretching from India to Ethiopia.

description: The birth of Jesus in Bethlehem
alt: A mother and newborn in a manger in a stable at night, with shepherds kneeling.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. Luke mentions a manger; the stable setting and star over the shepherds are traditional artistic details.

alt: A teacher seated on a green hillside by a lake addresses a large crowd.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The people's appearance is imagined and deliberately varied. Luke 6:17 says the crowd included people from the coast of Tyre and Sidon.

alt: A small boat tossed by waves at night as a calm figure stretches out his arm.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

alt: A traveller kneels to bandage a wounded man on a rocky road while two others walk away.
interpretation_note: Illustration of a parable (a story Jesus told), not a historical event.

description: The return of the prodigal son
alt: An elderly father runs to embrace his ragged son on a country road.
interpretation_note: Illustration of a parable (a story Jesus told), not a historical event.

alt: Men and women with a range of skin tones in an upper room, small flames resting above their heads.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The people's appearance is imagined; Acts 2:5-11 names visitors from many nations, including Egypt, Libya, Arabia and Mesopotamia.

alt: A Roman ship breaks apart on rocks while passengers swim toward an island beach.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The people's appearance is imagined and deliberately varied. Acts 27 describes 276 people aboard a ship of Alexandria.

alt: Beneath a stormy sea, an enormous fish rises toward a man while a ship tosses above.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. Scripture says 'a great fish' without naming a species.

alt: Women carrying spices approach a rock-cut tomb whose stone has been rolled away.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

alt: A shepherd kneels barefoot before a bush that burns without burning up, his sandals and rod beside him and sheep on the slope.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

alt: A traveller sleeps with his head on a stone while angels go up and down a shining ladder into the night sky.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

alt: Priests blow rams' horn trumpets and carry the gilded ark around a walled city, with a scarlet cord hanging from a window.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The ark's appearance follows Exodus 25:10-22; the city and clothing are imagined. The people's appearance is imagined and deliberately varied.

description: Ruth gleaning in the field of Boaz
alt: A young woman gleans barley behind reapers in a golden field while the landowner speaks with her.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

alt: Two ravens bring bread and meat to a prophet sitting by a brook in a rocky ravine.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

alt: Builders rebuild a stone wall and gate; one lays stones while holding a sword, a man on the wall blows a trumpet, and a leader holds a scroll.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The scroll stands for the king's letters (Nehemiah 2:7-9); the leader's appearance is imagined. Scripture says the builders had their swords girded by their sides (Nehemiah 4:18); showing one in hand is artistic.

alt: In the Jordan river a man in camel's hair stands beside Jesus as a dove descends from an opening sky.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

alt: A servant draws wine from one of six stone waterpots while the ruler of the feast tastes a cup at a village wedding.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The people's appearance is imagined and deliberately varied.

alt: A boy offers five barley loaves and two small fishes to Jesus as a great crowd sits on the grass, with baskets of leftovers nearby.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The people's appearance is imagined and deliberately varied.

alt: On a stormy lake at night Jesus walks on the water and catches Peter's hand as he sinks, a boat behind them.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

alt: A short man in rich clothes sits in a sycomore tree above a crowd while Jesus looks up and calls him.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The people's appearance is imagined and deliberately varied.

alt: Jesus rides a young donkey toward Jerusalem as people spread garments on the road and wave palm branches.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. Scripture mentions the colt (Mark 11:7), garments and branches spread in the way (Matthew 21:8) and branches of palm trees (John 12:13); faces, clothing and composition are imagined. The people's appearance is imagined and deliberately varied.

alt: Jesus breaks bread at a low table with his apostles in an upper room, a cup of wine before him.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The seating and room are imagined; Luke 22:12 calls it a large upper room furnished. The people's appearance is imagined and deliberately varied.

alt: A man bound in white graveclothes walks out of a cave tomb as Jesus stands before it and mourners watch.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

description: Saul on the road to Damascus
alt: A man has fallen on a road under a blinding light from heaven while two companions stand speechless and a pack donkey waits, with the walled city of Damascus in the distance.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. Scripture mentions men journeying with Saul who stood speechless (Acts 9:7) but not how many there were or whether they had animals; their number and the donkey are imagined.

alt: Fishermen in two boats haul a net so full of fish that it is breaking, while Jesus sits in one boat.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.

alt: Wise men kneel in a house before a mother and young child, offering gold, frankincense and myrrh, with a star outside.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. Matthew does not say how many wise men came; three is traditional, from the three gifts.

description: Moses with the tablets at Sinai
alt: Moses comes down a smoking mountain carrying two stone tablets, with a camp of tents in the valley below.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture. The writing on the tablets is shown as unreadable marks.

alt: A farmer scatters seed over a field with a path where birds eat seed, stony ground, thorns and good soil.
interpretation_note: Illustration of a parable (a story Jesus told), not a historical event.
